objective: Implement C03/C06 CreativeComposition and provider-neutral local FFmpeg render pipeline yielding playable MP4 with immutable manifest/diagnostics, without A06/M1 overclaims.
acceptance: Freeform intent and valid asset source can become immutable editable Composition IR, without scene/storyboard quota.
Render PNG/JPEG/WebP to playable MP4, and multi-scene ordered stills; actual output validated by ffprobe plus decode with hash on reopen.
Absent media/FFmpeg or bad codec fails with actionable diagnostics; timeout and interrupted process do not become false SUCCEEDED.
A03/A04 V1 and v1.1 records and CLI remain readable; no mandatory live provider/model/account.
Render manifest identifies composition revision, source asset hashes, encoder configuration and actual artifact bytes, not fictional video.
risk_notes: A05 source implementation is not A06/E01 or M1 proof.
Real Windows FFmpeg/ffprobe availability not yet observed.
Technical video render PASS does not guarantee semantic creative realization.
